## Languages and coverage

List language names and codes, dialect/variant information, geography at a safe level of aggregation, crop/livestock topics, and known coverage gaps.

## Sources and provenance

For each source category, document collection method, source citation, date range, rights basis, consent where required, and transformation history. Do not release confidential source materials or identifying metadata.

## License and permitted use

State the dataset license or access terms. Include third-party rights and attribution obligations. If redistribution rights are unknown, do not publish the records.

## Collection and processing

Describe annotation instructions, translations, deduplication, normalization, filtering, and quality checks. Record code and pipeline versions.

## Review labels

Define canonical labels and counts: pending, needs_revision, rejected, approved. Explain who reviews language quality, agronomic correctness, and evidence/source quality. Do not publish reviewer identities unless explicitly authorized.

## Publication versus training eligibility

Explain that publicly shareable records are not necessarily approved for training. Document the additional approvals, privacy checks, rights checks, safety screening, and leakage controls required before training.

## Splits and leakage controls

Describe how records are grouped and split, duplicate handling, near-duplicate detection, and checks preventing related examples from crossing train/validation/test boundaries.

## Intended and prohibited use

Describe responsible uses, known limitations, prohibited use, and risks of overgeneralizing from the dataset.

## Privacy and consent

Describe de-identification, sensitive field removal, retention, consent, and handling of removal requests. Do not reveal private data in this card.

## Known limitations

List representation gaps, possible annotation errors, uneven language coverage, and areas requiring further review.

## Citation

Provide the preferred dataset citation and related publications.
